script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Jupiter is forming a powerful trine to your ruling planet Venus, flooding your 1st House of self-expression with expansive, joyful energy that amplifies your Earth sign's natural sensuality and practical charm. In love, if you're single, this transit makes you magnetically attractive; embrace your confident warmth to draw in someone who appreciates your stability. If you're taken, your partner may need extra reassurance as Mars squares your 7th House of partnerships, so avoid defensiveness today. Career-wise, Mercury in your 10th House of reputation is sextile Pluto, signaling a chance to make a bold move that could transform your professional path and bring significant recognition. A sudden insight about a shared resource might surprise you—could be a blessing or a warning. Trust your instincts but avoid impulsive contracts. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
